description:
Cross Platform Xray-core Client

OneXray is a cross-platform Xray-core client for managing proxy configurations and VPN/TUN connections.
More routing options and Android automation
- Fragment routing: Optional TLS ClientHello fragmentation in Smart Routing and ordinary Custom Routing, off by default. Advanced Custom Routing can supply its own Fragment outbound and parameters.
- LAN proxy sharing: An optional HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy for other devices on a trusted network, with a configurable port. It is off by default, has no authentication, and applies when VPN is next started from OneXray. Complete Raw JSON keeps control of its own inbounds.
- Android automation: Allow trusted tools such as Tasker or Automate to start and stop VPN through token-protected broadcasts. The feature is off by default and reuses the last configuration generated by an in-app connection.
- Windows VPN integration: Updated Microsoft Store system-VPN integration to Vole, refined runtime cleanup and packaging, and corrected the oversized X in Start-menu and pinned MSIX icons. EXE/ZIP continue to use Xray native TUN.
- Configuration and connection handling: Updated Xray configuration compatibility, simplified import/save validation, and improved startup failure handling and cleanup.
Changes are based on v26.9.5 through v26.10.2. Existing connections and settings can be retained when updating; the new Fragment, LAN sharing and Android automation switches remain off until enabled.
LAN sharing follows the selected routing rules and is available only while its VPN runtime is running. Saving a sharing change does not change an existing listener; start VPN from the app to apply it. Widgets, tiles, automation and Apple on-demand starts reuse the last generated configuration. Apple does not support hosting proxy listeners in Packet Tunnel Providers; LAN sharing is not advertised as a supported Apple background-proxy service.
OneXray remains a bring-your-own-server client with no account, ads, or app analytics.
Update guide · Android automation · Source changes: v26.9.5 → v26.10.2
